recognize_zh: CD3 只標出散在或成群的反應性小 T 淋巴球，而背景中密集的中大型腫瘤細胞為陰性，說明腫瘤不是 T 細胞來源，符合 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Scattered and loosely clustered CD3-positive small reactive T cells with membranous/cytoplasmic staining
Positive T cells concentrated in a band across the field, possibly perivascular or residual stroma
No aberrant CD3 staining in the tumor sheet
describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry shows that the sheets of medium to large neoplastic cells are negative. Scattered and focally clustered small reactive T lymphocytes are positive, forming a band across the field. The absence of CD3 in the tumor cells, together with CD20 positivity, supports a B-cell lymphoma, consistent with the high-grade B-cell lymphoma in this case.

ddx.vs: PTCL shows CD3 positivity in the atypical large cells, not only in small background lymphocytes.
THRLBCL has abundant CD3-positive T cells surrounding rare large B cells, rather than sheets of CD3-negative tumor cells with few T cells.
